meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把长任务的计划和进展记进文件,中断后自动接着往下做
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务要跑很多步工具调用、中途容易断线或丢掉进度
copy.tagline_en: Keep plans and progress for long tasks in files, then resume right where you left off
copy.fit_line_en: For you if tasks need many tool calls and often break or lose progress midway

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会在你的项目目录里建 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件,把任务阶段、研究发现和进度写进磁盘,上下文丢失或 /clear 后仍能接着做。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、拆解或整理多步骤项目、研究任务,或这项工作预计需要 5 次以上工具调用时触发。

say.text: 把这个重构任务拆成几个阶段,写进 task_plan.md
say.note: 生成计划文件,之后每完成一阶段就更新状态

say.text: 读一下 .planning 里的计划,继续上次没做完的活
say.note: 会读取磁盘上的计划和进度接着干

say.text: 把刚查到的结论记到 findings.md
say.note: 把研究发现落盘,避免上下文丢失

howto.what_en: Installs persistent planning files in your project dir: task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md. Claude writes phases, findings and progress to disk so work survives context loss and /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan, break down or organize a multi-step project or research task, or for work needing 5+ tool calls.

say_en.text: Break this refactor into phases and write them into task_plan.md
say_en.note: Creates the plan file and updates status per phase

say_en.text: Read the plan in .planning and continue the unfinished work
say_en.note: Reads plan and progress from disk and resumes

say_en.text: Save what you just found into findings.md
say_en.note: Writes findings to disk so context loss won't erase them
